title: Nice Tumbler!
text: Nice Tumbler!. I'm trying to increase my daily water. Fun, pretty cups make it a little easier. This style is pretty popular right now. The textured sides help me grip it better than if it had smooth sides. It's a hand wash only item. The double insulated walls seem to prevent the cup from sweating so far. It could be that I don't put a lot of ice in my cups, but I do put some in.
